Expected Condition: Every required field should contain a value.
The same complete record should not appear more than once.
Product ID should uniquely identify a record.
Date must be valid and within 2025.
Quantity must be a positive whole number.
Category must be Furniture, Office Supplies, or Technology.
Sub-Category must belong to its Category.
Region must be Central, East, South, or West.
Segment must be Consumer, Corporate, or Home Office.
A Product Name should map consistently to Category/Sub-Category.
